name: Wife in the Building!
source: A couple moves into a new apartment building for inconvenient reasons. With their savings depleted, they embark on an adventure with the characters around them so that one day they can realize their dream. Swinging/sharing/netorase will be the main focus of the game. There will be no cheating and humiliation.​
